process.name: Utility - Encryption
process.narrative: Provides symmetric encryption and decryption functionality in several algorithms (AES, Triple DES, Rjindael)

stage.name: Stage1
Encrypt
stage.narrative: Encrypt text data using a selected algorithm

input.name: Key
input.narrative: [Optional] The secret key that should be used to encrypt the data. If no key is available, this action will generate and return a new key.

input.name: Algorithm
input.narrative: [Optional] The name of the algorithm to use for encryption. Valid values are: AES, TDES, Rjindael.

output.name: Encrypted Data
output.narrative: The input data in encrypted form

output.name: New Key
output.narrative: If no key was supplied in the input parameter (named Key), then a new key will be generated and stored in this data item.

stage.name: Key
stage.narrative: [Optional] The secret key that should be used to encrypt the data. If no key is available, this action will generate and return a new key.

stage.name: Algorithm
stage.narrative:
[Optional] The name of the algorithm to use for encryption. Valid values are: AES, TDES, Rijndael
If no value is supplied, AES will be used by default.

stage.name: Encrypted Data
stage.narrative: The input data in encrypted form

stage.name: New Key
stage.narrative:
If no key was supplied in the input parameter (named Key), then a new key will be generated and stored in this data item.
Otherwise, if a Key was supplied, this data item will remain empty.

stage.name: Choose Algorithm
stage.narrative: Determine which algorithm should be used to encrypt the data

exception.detail: "Invalid value for [Algorithm] data item. The value must be one of the following: AES, TDES, Rijndael. Current value for [Algorithm]: " & [Algorithm]
